topic: Market Direction Prediction — next-week and next-month signals
agenda_context: CIO wants system to predict where market goes next week / next month (up/down/good/bad/full deployment opportunity). Previous direction engine proposal (10 signals, A01b separate engine) was rejected as unnecessary. New approach: identify what practitioners actually use, backtest, only add what clears evidence bar.

research_report.key_finding: No single signal has >65% hit rate at any horizon. Best practitioners don't predict direction — they identify conditions as PERMISSIVE vs HOSTILE. AlphaAbsolute philosophy is already correct.
next_week_leaders: VIX/VIX3M term structure ratio (~60-62% hit rate, academic evidence)
Dealer GEX (65-70% for vol REGIME, not direction — different thing)
next_month_leaders: Leader stock breakout failure rate — O'Neil: led every major top by 4-6 weeks (12 of 13 major tops). Best documented practitioner signal.
HY spread 4W rate of change (not level) — Druckenmiller's #1 leading macro signal. BIS/NBER academic backing.
A-D Line divergence — Ned Davis Research, ~65-70% at identifying tops, 2-8 week lead.
what_practitioners_avoid: Aggregate P/C ratio (contaminated by institutional hedges)
RSI/MACD at index level (coincident, not leading)
GDP/ISM/unemployment (6-9 month lag for equity direction)
VIX absolute level (direction and structure matter, not level)

quant_report.evidence_bar: Combined score ≥12/20 (Lead Time Quality × Evidence Strength). Minimum OOS hit rate meaningful above 53% (random baseline 50%, momentum baseline 54%).

VIX_Term_Structure.verdict: REJECTED as direction, add as vol flag

breadth_health_score_proposal.description: Consolidate 3 approved signals into single 0-100 score for A01

thresholds.40_to_70: Neutral — regime per current A01 logic
thresholds.below_40: Distribution warning — cross-reference distribution day count

NAAIM_RoC.result: CONDITIONAL — re-entry timing only, not regime signal

VIX_VXV_Ratio.result: APPROVED as vol flag in A02

architecture_decision: NOT a separate A01b engine. Enhance A01 + A02 directly. All 3 direction signals add as Breadth Health Score to A01 composite. HY ROC and VIX/VXV go to A02. No new scripts.
backtest_gate: All fields start as HYPOTHESIS in signal_weights.json. Mechanical adjustment to regime thresholds requires N≥52 weekly observations. Current status: N=0, no observations yet.

BOA-001-A6: Breadth Health Score composite in A01 (Easy)
next_meeting_trigger: After 52 weekly observations of Breadth Health Score — compare to regime transition accuracy. Estimated: 2026-Q4.
